rapport_notes: Warm and pleasant, patient with email spelling and a small, simple job.

evidence_quotes.agenda: let's talk about your move. What are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: I guess I want to know if you guys assemble and disassemble a bed frame. (answered once, straight pivot to logistics, no 'anything else on your mind')

top_strength: Made the explicit close ask directly and confidently even on a small, low-ticket move.
coaching_note: Answered the one concern raised (assembly) but never asked 'anything else on your mind' to surface more, and skipped the differentiator recap (damage coverage, meet-your-mover, on-time guarantee) entirely.
